plugins.description: Swarm intelligence prediction: build a high-fidelity parallel digital world from seed information, thousands of agents with independent personas/memory/behavior freely interact and socially evolve, inject variables god's-eye view to deduce future trajectories
plugins.author: satan9394

plugins.name: dsh-hallmark-design
plugins.description: Anti-AI-slop UI design: 21 themes + macrostructure per brief, 57 slop-test gates + pre-emit self-critique, refuses on-distribution LLM defaults; four verbs (build / audit / redesign / study-DNA), Custom from-scratch mode.
plugins.author: satan9394

plugins.name: dsh-agent-reach
plugins.description: One-click internet capability for AI agents: 15+ platforms (web/YouTube subtitles/RSS/search/GitHub/X/Bilibili/Reddit/FB/IG/Xiaohongshu/LinkedIn/V2EX/Xueqiu/podcasts), zero-config first, multi-backend routing auto-failover, doctor diagnostics, cookies stay local.
plugins.author: satan9394

plugins.name: dsh-harness-os
plugins.description: Agent harness config OS: four-layer separation (rules persistent / skills on-demand / agents specialized / hooks runtime), instincts continuous learning (+/evolve clustering), AgentShield security audit (secrets/hook-injection/MCP risk), Unified Memory Vault across harnesses, GateGuard destructive-command gate.
plugins.author: satan9394

plugins.name: dsh-self-improving-agent
plugins.description: Self-improving AI agent: built-in closed learning loop (auto-create skills from experience, improve during use, FTS5 session search + LLM summaries for cross-session recall, Honcho dialectic user modeling), cross-platform gateway (Telegram/Discord/Slack/WhatsApp), cron natural-language scheduling, subagent parallelism, serverless hibernate/wake.
plugins.author: satan9394

plugins.name: dsh-social-simulation
plugins.description: Million-agent social simulation: scalable open-source social-media simulator where LLM agents mimic up to 1M users on Twitter/Reddit-style platforms, 23 actions, interest/hot-score recommendation, dynamic environments
plugins.author: satan9394

plugins.name: dsh-autonomous-research
plugins.description: Autonomous LLM training research: give an agent a small real training setup to experiment overnight (edit code → fixed 5-min train → check val_bpb → keep/discard loop, ~12 experiments/hour), single-file modification, program.md as ultra-lightweight skill.
plugins.author: satan9394

plugins.name: dsh-cloud-well-architected
plugins.description: Cloud Well-Architected six-pillar review: reliability (user-experience goals, SLO + error budgets, cross-region redundancy, horizontal scaling, golden signals, graceful degradation, recovery tests, blameless postmortems), cost, operational excellence, performance, security, sustainability.
plugins.author: satan9394

plugins.name: dsh-skill-optimization
plugins.description: Train agent skills like neural networks: epochs/batchsize/learning-rate/validation gates without touching model weights, rollout→reflect→aggregate→select→update→evaluate loop, candidate edits accepted only on strict held-out improvement, zero inference-time overhead, deploy compact best_skill.md.
plugins.author: satan9394

plugins.name: dsh-geo-seo
plugins.description: GEO-first AI search optimization: optimize sites for AI engines (ChatGPT/Claude/Perplexity/Gemini/AI Overviews), citability scoring, AI crawler analysis, llms.txt generation, brand-mention scanning, Schema + E-E-A-T, 5 parallel subagent full audit.
plugins.author: satan9394

plugins.name: dsh-virtual-eng-team
plugins.description: Virtual engineering team: 23 specialist roles (CEO rethinks product, eng manager locks architecture, designer catches AI slop, reviewer finds prod bugs, QA opens a real browser, security officer runs OWASP+STRIDE, release engineer ships PRs), slash-command flow /office-hours → /autoplan → /review → /qa → /ship.
plugins.author: satan9394

plugins.name: dsh-knowledge-brain
plugins.description: Knowledge brain layer: search gives pages, brain gives cited answers
plugins.author: satan9394

plugins.name: dsh-channel-assistant
plugins.description: Channel-first personal assistant: one Gateway connects models/tools/messaging channels/companion apps, channels-as-interface (WhatsApp/Telegram/Slack/Discord/Signal/iMessage), Control UI/CLI/TUI, pairing-based security for unknown senders, sandboxed tool execution, ClawHub plugin ecosystem.
plugins.author: satan9394

plugins.name: dsh-desktop-agent-gui
plugins.description: Desktop GUI for agent orchestration: zero-config wizard, intelligent chat (@agent routing, inline skill cards, doc previews), multi-channel multi-account management, cron automation delivering to external channels, local-first skill management, keychain-secured provider credentials.
plugins.author: satan9394

plugins.name: dsh-model-gateway
plugins.description: Model routing gateway: one endpoint to 290+ AI providers (90+ free, 1200+ models), Claude Code/Codex/Cursor/Cline/Copilot compatible, quota-aware auto-fallback, 19 routing strategies, RTK+Caveman stacked compression saving 15-95% tokens, honest free-tier budget (~1.5B tokens/mo).
plugins.author: satan9394

plugins.name: dsh-parallel-agent-ade
plugins.description: Parallel agent development environment: Codex/ClaudeCode/OpenCode/Pi side-by-side each in its own git worktree, fan one prompt across agents and merge the winner, mobile companion monitoring, Design Mode (click UI element → HTML/CSS/screenshot into prompt), SSH remote worktrees, annotate-AI-diff loop.
plugins.author: satan9394

plugins.name: dsh-taste-review
plugins.description: Taste-driven judgment call for ambiguous decisions: state the question plainly, list files to consider, weigh a few options, give recommendation with alternatives; depth matches the decision weight
plugins.author: satan9394

plugins.name: dsh-test-desktop-app
plugins.description: Electron desktop app E2E testing via CDP: connect to real Chromium renderer for DOM inspection, JS evaluation, clicks, and screenshots; DPR×2 multiplier, real Input.dispatchMouseEvent for right-clicks, stacking checks for popup screenshots, debounced xterm refit.
plugins.author: satan9394

plugins.name: dsh-req-miner
plugins.description: Requirements-mining sidebar plugin: per-session floating interview window driven by a continuable subagent (decision tree + frontier questions), reads the bound session's workspace and recent context, one-click return of the summarized requirement prompt to the composer. Install: `github:nortejiang-tech/dsh-req-miner`.
plugins.author: nortejiang-tech

plugins.name: dsh-agnes-paseo
plugins.description: Agnes AI model gateway (OpenAI-compatible) for dsh, plus a zero-dependency ACP bridge that registers DeepSeek Harness as a Paseo provider.
plugins.author: vvlife
plugins.notes: 需本机有 pnpm（dsh plugin 依赖它）。装完在 profile 目录跑 pnpm exec dsh-agnes-paseo-setup --key sk-... 完成 Agnes 凭据写入与 Paseo provider 注册，再 paseo daemon restart。Paseo 里每个 prompt 回合是一次独立的 dsh headless 运行，回合间不保留上下文。

plugins.name: dsh-paseo-mobile
plugins.description: Connect your phone to dsh via Paseo: one-command setup registers dsh as a Paseo provider (zero-dependency ACP bridge), then scan the pairing QR in the Paseo mobile app. Model-agnostic: follows your existing dsh model config; mirrors dsh web sessions to the phone with context-aware follow-ups.
plugins.author: vvlife
plugins.notes: 模型无关，不改 dsh 模型配置（与 dsh-agnes-paseo 互补）。装完在 profile 目录跑 pnpm exec dsh-paseo-mobile-setup --restart-daemon：复制 ACP 桥、探测当前默认模型写 provider.json、注册 Paseo provider；然后 paseo daemon pair 出二维码，手机 Paseo App 扫码即连。dsh web 会话可在 Paseo 导入镜像到手机，追问带上下文注入；Paseo 新建 agent 的回合间不保留上下文。

plugins.name: dsh-mini-games
plugins.description: Pure-frontend mini-game collection in the web details panel: guess-the-number, 2048, minesweeper (`dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mini-games`).
plugins.author: aga-j

plugins.name: dsh-deploy-share
plugins.description: HTML preview deploy & share buttons: one-click deploy to free account-less anonymous hosting and copy the live link.
plugins.author: vvlife
plugins.notes: 依赖 dsh-better-sidebar（经 ctx.betterSidebar 注册高优先级 HTML viewer）。部署经插件 host 路由 /deploy-share/upload 转发免账号托管（html.cafe → catbox.moe → envs.sh），上传后回读校验 text/html + CSP 放行内联脚本 + 响应体含内容标记，失败自动换下一家。装完重启 dsh web。

plugins.name: dsh-session-nav
plugins.description: 会话对话快捷导航：右侧悬浮按钮，hover 弹出完整历史提问列表，点击快速跳转
plugins.author: tuogusa
plugins.notes: 兼容 Profile: web；git 安装需在 profile 的 pnpm-workspace.yaml 添加 allowBuilds；装完重启 + Ctrl+Shift+R

plugins.name: dsh-deepseek-balance
plugins.description: 实时显示 DeepSeek 开发平台余额

plugins.notes: 依赖 omdsh-base 的模式切换器；终端运行在独立 profile（默认 omdsh-tui，需按该仓库说明安装）。

plugins.name: omdsh-sidepanel
plugins.description: Work 模式下的右侧文件树与底部终端侧栏
plugins.author: omdsh-plugins
plugins.notes: 仅 Work 模式显示；可选依赖 omdsh-remdev（远程开发服务）。

plugins.name: omdsh-sidechat
plugins.description: 侧边对话：锚定当前浏览内容，在独立会话中提问，不打扰主会话

plugins.name: omdsh-usage

plugins.author: omdsh-plugins

plugins.name: omdsh-remdev

plugins.author: omdsh-plugins

plugins.name: omdsh-remctrl

plugins.author: omdsh-plugins
plugins.notes: 当前为 M0（门与锁）；面向 tailnet 内手机远程查看会话与审批。

plugins.name: omdsh-shortcuts
plugins.description: 一键绑定命令的快捷键系统，桌面菜单与网页共用一份配置
plugins.author: omdsh-plugins

plugins.name: dsh-prompt-optimize
plugins.description: 对 composer 当前草稿做辅助 LLM 改写；点击只替换草稿，不发送消息、不开回合
plugins.author: peterliucius
plugins.notes: 兼容 Profile: web（占用 conversation.input.right，需要已有 web Client Remote gateway）；不兼容默认 headless（无 composer UI）。Windows 上若 git 依赖 symlink 报 EPERM，可在 pnpm-workspace.yaml 加 packageImportMethod: copy。

plugins.name: omdsh-plughub
plugins.description: omdsh 插件中心：在设置页里安装、移除并配置整套 omdsh 插件
plugins.author: omdsh-plugins
plugins.notes: npm 已发布；安装后重启生效，Settings → Plugins → OMDSH Plugins 中可安装其余插件。
